messages:
lina_sales: quick sync Zenith is asking for a 3-week POC to validate SSO (Okta) + SCIM provisioning + strict tenant domain locking. they want group->role mapping and 1y audit retention for HIPAA. can we scope and price?

omar_se: short: SAML supported (IdP & SP). SCIM v2 with PATCH/delta supported. Console has group->role mapping and canary role rollouts. domain proofing works via TXT + tenant claim checks.

pat_infosec: checklist: signed assertions required; Zenith requires encrypted assertions. NameID persistent preferred. cert rotation cadence? we can do default 90d but they want 1yr plan documented. need audit trail for provisioning and admin events. also want session idle timeout 15m.

tasha_ops: pricing note: recommend Hosted for quick trial unless BAA/HSM required. Hosted POC estimate $1.1k/week baseline + SCIM overage; Dedicated trial (3w reserved) ~ $3.2k one-time for reservation + GPU hours; Private custom (HSM + deployment). Hosted audit logs default 90d; enterprise add-on extends to 1y.

lina_sales: @zenith_pls can you share expected DAU and provisioning spikes so we can decide Dedicated? also please provide SP metadata and a sample Okta groups CSV.

zenith_contact (via DM): DAU ~9k, onboarding steady ~1.5k/wk, migration spikes up to 5k/day. HIPAA applies. audit retention 1y required. will provide metadata and group export.

omar_se: SCIM throughput guidance: Hosted default 600 reqs/min, Dedicated burst 1200. PATCH is strongly recommended for deltas. sample PATCH payload we use: 
```
PATCH /Users/8f3a1
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{ "op": "replace", "path": "emails[type eq \"work\"].value", "value": "alex@zenith.com" }]
}
```

deploy-bot: INF-5012 created  reserve Dedicated test node for zenith-poc (1x A10g equiv) 3-week window. assigned: eng-runtime.

pat_infosec: action items: exchange SP certs for assertion encryption. confirm NameID format (persistent) and session timeout 15m. need to confirm IP allowlist for SSO endpoints.

tasha_ops: action items: I'll prepare a POC pricing sheet (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and include BAA path for HIPAA. Hosted BAA possible but recommend Dedicated/Private. will include audit log retention options and KMS integration notes.

lina_sales: SOW plan outline: week1 domain proofing + SAML smoke tests, week2 SCIM group sync + RBAC mapping + canary access, week3 scale test with migration spike and final sign-off. target SOW draft by EOD.

omar_se: RBAC mapping example to include in SOW: `okta:group==\"zenith:admins\" -> role:tenant_admin` and canary flag `rbac.canary=true` for 1% first rollout.

pat_infosec: also flag: cert rotation docs and SOC2 artifact links will be attached. prefer Dedicated for customer KMS key-wrap; Private for HSM.

lina_sales: thanks team I'll collect metadata and send SOW to Zenith legal/infosec. :thumbsup:
